div.head: III Atr 10
div.ab: ⁊ ælc flyma beo flyma on ælcum lande, þe on ánum sy.
Et omnis flima sit flima in omni terra, qui fuerit in una.
⁊ ælc flyma beo flyma on ælcum lande þe on ánum sy.
Und jeder Friedlose, der in Einer [Landschaft friedlos] ist, sei in jeder Landschaft friedlos.
And let every outlaw who is [an outlaw] in one [district] be an outlaw in every district.
And everyone who is an outlaw in one district shall be an outlaw everywhere.
And every fugitive, who is a fugitive in one district, is to be so in every district.
div.note: AP: added from Whitelock p. None, October 2026 (Whitelock’s translation)

note.seg: ‘Land’ meint hier vielleicht den Sprengel Eines ordentlichen öffentlichen Gerichts; s. d. Gl 3ff.; friedlos 4. 6. 17
‘Land’ here perhaps means the district of a single regular public court; see that word in Gl 3ff.; friedlos 4. 6. 17
